new_jobs.jd: * 與國際級 PE 投資人及關鍵利害關係人密切合作, 直接參與企業 IPO 規劃與資本市場布局 * 站在企業決策核心，參與公司治理、策略發展及跨國營運規劃, 從高速成長到資本市場轉型的重要推手 **About Our Client** 我們的客戶是一家快速成長中的創新科技企業，擁有海外市場布局與國際化發展藍圖。企業目前正處於組織升級與資本市場規劃的重要階段，並獲具影響力投資機構支持，持續強化公司治理與經營體質，為未來更大規模發展奠定基礎。本職務將作為 CEO 的核心策略夥伴，負責推動公司治理、IPO 專案管理、營運優化及策略發展，並與投資人、董事會及外部專業機構密切合作，協助企業邁向下一階段成長。 **Job Description** 資本市場規劃與 IPO 推動 * 主導 IPO 規劃與執行，協調券商、會計師及法律顧問等外部機構 * 協助建立符合資本市場期待之財務及營運指標 * 推動營收成長及獲利能力提升，達成上市準備目標 * 協助董事會及管理團隊制定資本市場策略 公司治理與組織升級 * 建立完整公司治理架構及內控制度 * 優化董事會運作及決策管理機制 * 強化風險管理與法令遵循體系 * 建構符合公開發行企業要求之管理架構 商業策略與營運管理 * 協助 CEO 制定企業發展藍圖與成長策略 * 推動跨部門專案及營運效率提升 * 建立績效管理與目標追蹤機制 * 整合各部門資源以支持企業快速成長 JV 與 M&A 專案推進 * 參與合資企業評估、規劃與執行 * 參與併購評估及商業盡職調查 * 負責併購後整合作業及綜效提升 * 推動跨組織協作與國際合作專案 **The Successful Applicant** * 曾主導或深度參與 IPO 專案並成功完成上市櫃經驗 * 熟悉公司治理、董事會運作及內控制度 * 具備整體營運規劃與跨部門協作能力。 * 能將策略方向轉化為具體工作計畫與執行重點。 * 具備追蹤專案進度、整合資訊及推動事項落實的能力。 * 能與會計與財務團隊有效溝通，理解營運與資源配置需求。 * 具備流程檢視與改善能力，能提出務實可行的建議。 * 能協調不同利害關係人需求，建立清楚的合作方式。 **What's on Offer** * 與國際級 PE 投資人及關鍵利害關係人密切合作, 直接參與企業 IPO 規劃與資本市場布局 * 站在企業決策核心，參與公司治理、策略發展及跨國營運規劃, 從高速成長到資本市場轉型的重要推手 **Quote job ref: JN-112026-7139255**

new_jobs.jd: 【我們正在尋找的你】 如果你對電商營運、行銷具有高度的熱情； 如果你想挑戰透過營運，將產品送到真正需要的人手中； 如果你期待，你的工作可以讓更多人擁有更多美好的生活體驗； 歡迎與我們一起努力，為人類與社會的進步發展跨出一小步。 【工作內容】 1. 電商通路營運策略制定與年度規劃 依據公司年度目標與通路特性，制定各大電商平台（如 MOMO、蝦皮、官網 等）營運策略與成長節奏，建立通路年度／季度／月度計畫。 2. 熟悉各通路屬性及客群，並制定通路策略提升業績及市占率 ，協助團隊達成業績目標 3.業績追蹤與數據優化分析 即時追蹤每日業績、活動成效與平台數據，協助團隊制定優化方案（如流量來源、轉換率、庫存調整），提升經營績效 4. 帶領電商KA進行資源談判協調，爭取版位、資源曝光 5. 團隊管理與跨部門協作 協助團隊目標拆解與工作分配，與行銷、設計客服等部門協作，建立通路營運的有效執行流程與標準。 6. 主管交辦事項 【徵才條件-硬的個人經歷】 1.至少5年工作經驗。 2.對數字敏感、邏輯清楚、受挫力高。 * 3.熟悉 CYBERBIZE 優

new_jobs.title: Sales Operation Manager
new_jobs.jd: **About Corintis** Corintis offers innovative microfluidic cooling technologies for AI chips/GPUs and CPUs used in data centers. Working with many of the world’s largest tech companies, our solutions improve compute sustainability and tackle the excessive electricity consumption associated with data center cooling, which consumes more electricity than New York and London combined. Ranked as the No.1 Engineering startup in Switzerland for 2025, Corintis offers a friendly and team-oriented workplace, bringing together over 105 people from over 35 nationalities to solve the most significant computing challenges of tomorrow. Based in the EPFL Campus in St. Sulpice, we are closely connected to the local ecosystem and are located a few minutes walk from Lake Geneva. **The Role** As our Sales Operations Manager, you will own the critical transition point where a sales opportunity becomes a physical product. You will be the primary operational link between our Business Development team and our Engineering/Manufacturing teams. Your mission is to ensure that incoming purchase orders (POs) are seamlessly validated, tracked, and translated into manufacturing requirements, minimizing lead times and maximizing delivery accuracy for our global tech clients. **Key Responsibilities** * Manage the end-to-end PO lifecycle. Review incoming client orders for technical and commercial accuracy, cross-reference them against negotiated contracts/NDAs, and formally log them into our systems. * Act as the primary liaison between Sales and Manufacturing. Convert closed-won deals and custom PO specifications into actionable production demands for the engineering and cleanroom teams. * Monitor manufacturing timelines and cleanroom capacities to provide the sales team with accurate, real-time lead estimates for prospective clients. * Maintain and optimize our CRM data and ensure tight alignment with our manufacturing/ERP tracking systems to maintain a single source of truth from lead to delivery. * Partner with commercial leadership to provide manufacturing with rolling demand forecasts, allowing the production team to proactively procure raw materials and plan fabrication schedules. * Track order progress through the production pipeline and proactively communicate milestones, delays, or shipping logistics updates to the account managers. **Requirements** * 3–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Order Management, or Supply Chain Operations, specifically within a B2B advanced hardware, semiconductor, or complex manufacturing environment. * Proven track record handling complex purchase orders, custom product configurations, and multi-week or multi-month production lifecycles. * Deep experience working with CRMs (HubSpot/Salesforce) and ERP/Inventory management systems; experience setting up data bridges between Sales and Operations tools is highly valued. * Exceptional cross-functional communication skills; ability to easily speak the language of both quota-driven sales executives and precision-focused manufacturing engineers. * Elite attention to detail. You rarely let a mismatched SKU, pricing error, or delivery clause slip past your review. **This Is a Great Fit If You…** * Enjoy working in a startup environment * Want to build bridges between teams * See errors and anomalies easily * Want to create the rules and pioneer new technologies **This Won’t be The Right Role For You If…** * You need all of the rules to be written for you * Paving the way is not something that comes naturally to you * Working in a fast paced environment is something of a challenge

new_jobs.title: Country Manager
new_jobs.jd: **About Us** MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) is a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform that provides consumers with actionable insights to discover, compare, and choose the best financial products with confidence — bringing data intelligence and seamless digital access across insurance and banking solutions. new_jobs.title: Head of Product - Asian Timezones
new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview** hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades. **Job Overview** We are a discretionary crypto trading firm where traders and researchers make high-conviction decisions using proprietary data, tools, and workflows. Our edge depends not only on the quality of our people, but also on the internal systems that help them investigate markets, test ideas, understand risk, and act quickly with confidence. This is a founding Head of Product role. Today, product work is handled across trading, research, and engineering. Your mandate is to build the product function from the ground up: discovery, prioritization, requirements, roadmap ownership, product quality, adoption, and eventually the team. At our firm, "product" means internal, proprietary systems built for our own traders, researchers, and engineering teams. We do not build retail products, and we do not serve external customers. Your users are expert practitioners inside the firm. Your job is to understand their workflows deeply, identify the highest-leverage problems, and ensure engineering builds the right systems to solve them. You will start hands-on. You will sit with traders and researchers, understand real decisions and investigations, write the early requirements yourself, and establish the standards for how product work should be done. As the scope grows, you will hire and lead a small product team while staying close enough to the trading and research to retain a first-hand understanding of the problems we are solving. **Responsibilities** * Product Function and Operating Model Build the product discipline for the firm. Define how we discover problems, capture requirements, write specifications, review trade-offs, measure adoption, and close the feedback loop with users. * Internal Product Roadmap Own the roadmap for internal trading and research systems in partnership with the CIO, engineering, trading, and research leadership. Balance immediate practitioner pain points with longer-term platform foundations, including data quality, provenance, tooling reliability, and system scalability. * Practitioner Discovery Work directly with traders and researchers to understand real workflows: how they investigate opportunities, evaluate data, form hypotheses, monitor positions, assess risk, and make decisions. Your job is to understand the underlying decision process and identify what system capability would create the most leverage. * Requirements and Product Quality Translate ambiguous practitioner needs into clear, evidence-backed requirements that engineering can build from. Requirements should capture the business context, user workflow, data assumptions, expected behavior, edge cases, success measures, and relevant trade-offs. The goal is not simply to reduce questions from engineering. The goal is to reduce avoidable ambiguity, surface trade-offs early, and ensure the team is building the right thing for the right reason. * Trust, Explainability, and Source Transparency Ensure our internal systems are built for trust. Traders and researchers should be able to understand where a number came from, what assumptions sit behind a calculation, why a signal changed, and when human judgment is required. Data lineage, source transparency, explainable calculations, and human-in-the-loop decision-making should be default product principles. * Stakeholder Alignment Act as the connective tissue between trading, research, engineering, and management. You will surface trade-offs clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and help the firm make better prioritization decisions. * Team Building Start as the sole product leader, then build the team as the work scales. Hire and develop product managers, set the bar for discovery and specification quality, and create a product culture suited to a high-performance trading environment. **What You'll Do** * Spend significant time with traders and researchers to understand real decisions, workflows, investigations, datasets, and pain points * Distinguish stated feature requests from underlying practitioner needs * Translate trading and research workflows into product opportunities, clear requirements, and buildable product decisions * Write clear product requirements for internal systems, workflows, data products, analytics, and decision-support tools * Partner closely with engineering to shape feasible, scalable solutions and surface technical trade-offs early * Prioritize product work based on expected trading, research, operational, or risk impact * Define success measures for product work, including faster research cycles, better data quality, reduced manual work, improved decision confidence, risk reduction, stronger adoption, or, where measurable, PnL contribution * Defend foundational work — such as data quality, lineage, reliability, and platform architecture — when it is more important than a visible front-end feature * Evaluate external data providers and tooling vendors where relevant, including API quality, coverage, latency, reliability, cost, and integration complexity * Establish product rituals, documentation standards, and feedback loops * Advise the CIO on product priorities, practitioner needs, product-engineering trade-offs, and sequencing * Hire and lead a small product team once the scope requires it **Requirements** **Must Have** * 10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership in complex, technical, data-intensive environments * Experience building or scaling a product function, including hiring product managers, setting standards, and managing product work across multiple stakeholders * Strong experience with internal platforms, expert-user workflows, trading systems, research tooling, market data, financial technology, data infrastructure, or similarly complex product environments * The ability to work with highly specialized users, understand their workflows deeply, and translate ambiguous needs into clear product decisions * Strong technical and data fluency. You should be comfortable querying data, inspecting unfamiliar datasets, sanity-checking quality, and working closely with engineers on architecture and trade-offs * Excellent requirements-writing ability. You can produce specifications that are faithful to the user problem, clear enough for engineering, and tied to a business or workflow outcome * Strong product judgment. You know when to challenge a request, when to gather more evidence, when to escalate a trade-off, and when to commit once a decision is made * Clear written communication. We operate with a strong writing culture; important decisions, requirements, and trade-offs should be documented * The ability to move quickly without becoming sloppy. You can keep pace with trading and research cycles while maintaining rigor in a real-money environment * Independent judgment and the ability to disagree well. You can make a constructive argument with evidence, remain calm under pressure, and align behind a decision once it is made **Highly Valuable** * Experience at a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, quant manager, market maker, crypto trading firm, or financial data/platform company * Familiarity with crypto markets, including spot, perpetuals, funding rates, liquidity, on-chain data, unlock schedules, block explorers, and market microstructure * Experience evaluating market data,

new_jobs.title: Application Consultant-Banking Application Modernization
new_jobs.jd: **Introduction** A career in IBM Consulting is rooted by long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio; including Software and Red Hat. Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and development opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience. **Your Role And Responsibilities** As a Application Consultant you will serve as a client-facing practitioner who sells, leads and implements expert services utilizing the breadth of IBM's offerings and technologies. A successful Consultant is regarded by clients as a trusted business advisor who collaborates to provide innovative solutions used to solve the most challenging business problems. You will work on projects that help clients integrate strategy, process, technology, and information to increase effectiveness, reduce costs and improve profit and shareholder value. You can take advantage of opportunities to master new skills, work across different disciplines, move into new challenges and develop a robust understanding of different industries. **Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include** * Proposal Development: Identify clients’ business drivers, goals, and banking needs, and contribute to compelling proposals and value-driven business cases. Assess business requirements, solution scope, and implementation considerations to ensure proposed solutions are feasible and aligned with desired business outcomes. * Requirements Analysis and Specifications Design: Lead the analysis and clarification of clients’ business needs, banking processes, and business rules, translating them into clear, complete, and traceable requirements and implementable functional specifications. growth, operational excellence and a strong risk and control environment. **Role Location:** Taipei, Taiwan **Role Type:** Full-time, Permanent This job opening gives priority to people with disabilities. **What will your day look like?** As **Head of Technology, Taiwan** , you will: * Serve as the trusted technology advisor to the Country Senior Management Team, providing strategic technology leadership and business partnership to support country objectives. * Oversees the management and execution of the Technology function and its activities within ANZ Taiwan. * Lead the business value and operational efficiency. * Develop strong partnerships with business, operations and regional technology stakeholders to align local requirements with ANZ's global technology strategy. * Establish and oversee effective technology governance, service management and operational frameworks. * Drive a strong technology risk and control culture, ensuring the security, integrity and availability of systems and information. * Lead technology engagement with local regulators, ensuring compliance with regulatory obligations and managing audits, reviews and regulatory responses. oversight of technology risk, information security, cybersecurity governance and outsourcing arrangements in accordance with local regulatory requirements. * Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance across the Technology function. * Role model ANZ values and behaviours while promoting an inclusive and accountable team environment. **What will you bring?** To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring: * Significant experience within the banking and financial services industry, including leadership of complex technology functions and large application portfolios. * Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment, balancing business outcomes, technology delivery, risk management and regulatory requirements. * Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to, engaging with and leading executive and governance forums. * Demonstrated expertise in technology service management, including embedding governance frameworks, operating models and global standard processes. * Strong experience managing outsourced, offshore and cloud-based technology services and vendors. * Proven ability to lead technology risk, compliance and control activities, including supporting risk assessments and regulatory requirements. * Strong stakeholder management skills, with investment decisions. * Deep problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to navigate complexity, ambiguity and competing priorities. * Experience building high-performing teams, new_jobs.title: Manager, AI Product Development
new_jobs.jd: 負責 Media Practice 的 AI 產品策略、交付與營運。該產品是為媒體規劃提供消費者與市場洞察的 AI 產品，串接真人消費者調查數據與媒體規劃多代理系統，主要服務媒體與成效行銷團隊的 Planner、Buyer、Optimizer，也運用在客戶提案。你將對使用者價值、採用、輸出品質、模型成本與資料合規負責。 **Job Description:** **產品策略與路線圖** * 深入理解 Media Planner、Buyer、Optimizer 的工作流程，找出消費者洞察、受眾定義、媒體策略、預算配置、KPI 預估等場景的痛點與產品機會。 * 維護「受眾、規劃、活化」路線圖，依使用者價值、資料可用性、技術可行性、成本與風險排定優先順序，並清楚說明不做什麼。 * 追蹤外部 AI 與廣告科技工具及同業方案，評估尚未涵蓋的工作（例如成效行銷、下游執行）是否投入、何時投入。 **產品開發與 AI 品質** * 撰寫產品需求文件，內容包含使用情境、使用者流程、資料需求、AI 輸出要求與驗收標準（評測集、錯誤容忍度、需要人工覆核的情境）。 * 建立 AI 輸出的評估與回饋機制，檢查資料來源能否追溯、洞察是否合理、規劃是否可用，管理幻覺與錯誤引用數據的風險。 * 管理開發進度、相依事項與交付風險，在品質、時程與成本之間提出取捨。 * 與工程、數據、設計團隊合作，並和集團內其他 AI 產品（創意、洞察、消費者數位分身、內部 AI 平台）對齊介面、資料流與分工。 **內部導入與業務支援** * 與各業務單位規劃試用、教育訓練與種子教師機制，推動同仁持續使用，並把產品融入日常流程。 * 定期訪談與觀察使用者，把回饋轉成產品改善。 * 支援業務團隊在客戶提案中運用 AI 產品，清楚說明產品能力、資料依據與使用限制。 **成效、成本與治理** * 定義並追蹤採用與成效指標，包含目標使用者觸及、持續使用、任務完成率、作業時間節省、產出品質與提案應用案例。 * 追蹤模型用量與費用，分析各使用情境的成本效益，並與工程團隊協作優化。 * 與資料及治理團隊協作，落實調查數據與客戶資料的授權、權限與隱私要求，配合台灣與亞太區的產品治理審查。 * 定期向主管與高階主管報告進度、採用、成本與風險，並協調各業務單位之間的需求衝突。 **資格條件** * 理解媒體規劃或數位投放的流程與指標（受眾定義、預算分配、Reach／Frequency、CPM／CPA），能與 Planner、Optimizer 討論並轉成產品需求。 * 理解生成式 AI 的能力與限制，能與工程團隊討論 Prompt、RAG、Agent、評測與人工覆核的取捨。 * 中英文書面與口頭溝通流利。 **加分條件** * 具媒體代理商、媒體方或廣告科技工作經驗。 * 用過消費者調查數據。 * 具 LLM 評測、Multi-agent 系統或 AI 成本優化經驗。 * 推動過企業內部工具導入，例如教育訓練、種子使用者社群。 * 參與過 AI 治理、資料隱私或資安審查。 **Location:** Taipei - No. 77, Songgao Rd., Xinyi Dist. **Brand:** Dentsu **Time Type:** Full time **Contract Type:** Permanent

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
new_jobs.jd: **Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics?** Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics. At **Qnity** , we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries – we’re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. We value forward-thinking challengers, boundary-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us. The Qnity IT Technology Solutions team provides digital solutions that support data management, automation, computing, and analysis for R&D and engineering teams. We are seeking a scientifically-minded Data Scientist whose primary mission is to help our R&D teams capture the full value of the Uncountable platform. Working hands-on in Uncountable’s visualization, statistics, and machine-learning tools, this person partners with scientists to explore their experimental data, design and run design-of-experiments (DoE) studies, and drive formulation and process optimization. This is a build-and-grow role. The first priority is mastering the Uncountable platform and turning its capabilities into measurable wins for R&D. Over time, the role expands to developing analytical capabilities beyond the platform — extending the impact of data science across the R&D organization. Core Responsibilities * Partner directly with R&D teams to understand their scientific challenges, data, and experimentation workflows, then translate them into DoE and optimization studies on the Uncountable platform. * Use the platform’s visualization, statistical, and machine-learning tools to explore experimental data, surface key drivers and relationships, and recommend the next best experiments. * Onboard and coach R&D scientists on the platform — ensuring data is well-structured and models are configured to reflect their specific scientific context. * Help scientists interpret model outputs, act on recommendations, and build lasting confidence in model-guided experimentation. * Deliver measurable value: faster cycles, fewer experiments, and better-performing formulations and processes. Extending Impact Beyond the Platform * Develop custom analyses, models, and tools that complement Uncountable where its out-of-the-box capabilities stop short. * Connect insights from the platform with other R&D and enterprise data to answer broader scientific and business questions. * Build reusable methods, templates, and best practices that scale data science across R&D teams. * Help shape the broader R&D data science and AI roadmap alongside IT and digitalization partners. Technical & Scientific Partnership * Act as a go-to resource in statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimental design — advising R&D teams on strategies that maximize the value of their data. * Translate complex concepts into clear, actionable guidance for scientists and R&D leaders who may not have a data science background. * Troubleshoot modeling challenges, identify data-quality issues, and design solutions that make the science work. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration * Proactively identify gaps in current workflows or platform usage and propose improvements. * Collaborate with global IT and digitalization teams to align on best practices. * Contribute to reusable solutions and scalable implementation patterns. **Required Qualifications** * ML and data science foundation: comfortable with machine learning, statistical modeling, or applied statistics — including experimental design, model evaluation, and working with messy, real-world scientific data. * Scientific domain fluency: experience with R&D data, physical experimentation workflows, or scientific datasets — enough to speak credibly with researchers about their work. * Platform aptitude: curiosity and ability to quickly learn and apply a specialized R&D platform’s ML and optimization tools. Hands-on Uncountable experience is a plus, not a requirement — we will train. * Communication: ability to translate technical concepts into scientific and business value for audiences ranging from bench scientists to R&D leaders. * Software fluency: comfort with Python, statistical software, or similar data-science environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * M.S. or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related discipline. * Familiarity with Bayesian optimization, design of experiments (DoE), or active-learning methods in applied settings. * Exposure to product-development processes in materials, chemicals, or adjacent industries. * Ability to build capabilities beyond a single platform — e.g., custom models with Python ML libraries, dashboards, or data-visualization tools. * Prior experience with R&D data or experimentation platforms (Uncountable or similar) and integrating their outputs with other analytics.
